mapper.sql: SELECT CHRT.ORG_ID AS "orgId" , ORG.ORGNM AS "orgNm" , CHRT.DGRS_YR AS "haksaYear" , CHRT.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT AS "haksaTerm" , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRTNM AS "haksaTermNm" , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AS "smstrChrtId" , SBJ.CRS_GBNCD AS "crsGbncd" /* 공통코드명이 없으면 화면에는 '-'로 표시 */ /* 공통코드 미매칭 시 코드값을 그대로 노출하지 않도록 '-'로 표시 */ , NVL(CRS_GBNCD.CDNM, '-') AS "crsGbncdNm" , NVL(SBJCT_TYCD.CDNM, '-') AS "sbjctTycdNm" , SBJ.SBJCT_TYCD AS "sbjctTycd" , NVL(TO_CHAR(SBJ.CRCLMN_NO), '-') AS "crclmnNo" , SBJ.SBJCT_ID AS "sbjctId" , SBJ.SBJCTNM AS "sbjctNm" , NVL(TO_CHAR(SBJ.DVCLAS_NO), '-') AS "dvclasNo" , NVL(SBJ.DVCLAS_NO, 99999) AS "dvclasSortNo" , NVL(PROF.USERNM, SBJ.PROF_ID) AS "professorNm" , NVL(SBJCT_ADM.TUT_USERNM, '-') AS "tutorNm" , CASE WHEN SBJ.RVW_PSBL_GBNCD = 'PRD_STNG' THEN 'PRD_STNG' WHEN SBJ.RVW_PSBL_GBNCD = 'RVW_PSBL' THEN 'RVW_PSBL' ELSE 'RVW_IMPSBL' END AS "reviewStatus" , CASE WHEN SBJ.RVW_PSBL_GBNCD = 'PRD_STNG' THEN '기간설정' WHEN SBJ.RVW_PSBL_GBNCD = 'RVW_PSBL' THEN '영구' ELSE '불가' END AS "reviewStatusNm" , SBJ.RVW_SDTTM AS "reviewStartDttm" , SBJ.RVW_EDTTM AS "reviewEndDttm" , NVL(SBJ.USEYN, 'N') AS "useYn"

FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON CHRT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF ON PROF.USER_ID = SBJ.PROF_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ADM.SBJCT_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'TUT' THEN USR.USERNM END) AS TUT_USERNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = ADM.USER_ID GROUP BY ADM.SBJCT_ID ) SBJCT_ADM ON SBJCT_ADM.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD SBJCT_TYCD ON SBJCT_TYCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND SBJCT_TYCD.UP_CD = 'SBJCT_TYCD' AND SBJCT_TYCD.CD = SBJ.SBJCT_TYCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CRS_GBNCD ON CRS_GBNCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND CRS_GBNCD.UP_CD = 'CRS_GBNCD' AND CRS_GBNCD.CD = SBJ.CRS_GBNCD

) A
